_comment: The Windows whisper-cli.exe, FROZEN as a release asset instead of compiled per build.
It is the one thing in the Windows build that needed MSVC: sherpa-onnx and
onnxruntime ship as pinned upstream downloads, but whisper-cli.exe was compiled
from source with cmake -A x64 -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded so it
carries no Visual C++ redistributable dependency. macOS Docker cannot run MSVC,
and v1.4.0 moved Windows packaging off CI onto a local wine container (GitHub
Actions' free tier was exhausted in a day), so the binary is vendored here with
its provenance recorded rather than reproduced.
Nothing about the integrity chain changes: fetch-voice-assets.mjs verifies this
sha256 before staging it, the voice manifest hashes it again, and the ASAR trust
anchor pins the manifest. What changes is that the build no longer PRODUCES it.
TO CHANGE THE WHISPER PIN: this binary must be rebuilt on a real Windows machine
with MSVC (one windows-latest CI job on a pin change costs cents), and BOTH the
version and the sha256 below must move in the same commit as WHISPER_VERSION in
hud/scripts/fetch-voice-assets.mjs. A mismatch fails the build by design.
